protocol: G008 reproducible data split and evaluation seed lock

seed_roles.model_ppo_seed: TrainConfig.seed initializes Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA model and PPO randomness only; it is never an environment/game seed.
seed_roles.environment_roots: All G008 game/reset randomness is derived from the disjoint partition roots below using env-seed/v1; no global RNG or arithmetic offset is permitted.

benchmark.purpose: ephemeral G008 benchmark workload only; benchmark-derived artifacts cannot enter downstream consumers

validation.opponent_identity_policy: Exact frozen G007 step-300 checkpoint only; identity and current evaluation-runtime code/config hashes in frozen_evaluation_opponents.validation; prohibit this opponent and aliases from train, imitation_demo, reward, pool, benchmark, and final.

final.opponent_identity_policy: Exact open-space heuristic only; fingerprinted code/config and null model hash in frozen_evaluation_opponents.final; inaccessible except final evaluation after candidate freeze.
final.opponent_roster_mutability: forbidden; the exact single-opponent open-space roster, identity hashes, 512-game count, roots, and seats frozen in Phase A cannot be extended, substituted, or re-keyed.

opponent_assignment.training_and_imitation: Use only non-open-space heuristic styles (imitation) and self-play (training); no frozen validation/final opponent identity/hash or alias may enter training, imitation, reward design, benchmark strategy, or the opponent pool.

open_space_fingerprint.identity_scope: The fingerprint identifies the current open_space_action function source and the stated heuristic config; it is not a finalized complete game-level manifest.

config.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators (',', ':')

open_space_fingerprint.change_control: Any code edit that changes open_space_action requires re-freezing and re-reviewing this fingerprint before use.

seed_semantics.root_seed: A root seed is the reproducible game seed; for evaluation, every root seed is played once with each target seat, against the same identified opponent.
seed_semantics.partition_membership: A seed belongs only to the named partition. Validation/final opponent IDs are separately held out; seed disjointness alone does not establish opponent-identity or hash disjointness.

validation.game_index: target_seat (0 or 1), one independent initial episode per root/seat; reset_index=0

final.game_index: target_seat (0 or 1), one independent initial episode per root/seat; reset_index=0

environment_seed_codec.string_encoding: NFC UTF-8 framed by uint32 big-endian byte length
environment_seed_codec.integer_encoding: uint64 big-endian; optional N/A sentinel ffffffffffffffff

run_keys.measured: pair-00 through pair-04; shared by both paired backend sides
run_keys.imitation_demo: imitation-<same lowercase canonical UUID as run_id>; MUST differ from every train run UUID; binding is verified before any run registration/workload

train.binding: UUID suffix exactly equals registered run_id UUID

imitation_demo.binding: UUID suffix exactly equals registered run_id UUID
imitation_demo.non_alias: UUID must not equal any train run UUID

run_uuid_binding.canonical_uuid: lowercase RFC 4122 canonical UUID textual representation; reject uppercase, braces, noncanonical spelling, malformed UUID, or mismatch between run_id and run_key

schedule.allowed_duplicate: Only the identical environment tuple reused by incumbent and candidate sides of the same measured pair is allowed; all other derived-seed collisions fail closed.

opponents.provenance_note: Historical G007 training-code SHA is absent from the G007 manifest/metadata; do not claim this current G008 evaluator/runtime identity is the original G007 training build.

validation.seed_roster_order: root ascending, then target seat 0 then 1
validation.prohibition: This exact G007 step-300 model/checkpoint/opponent identity and all its aliases are forbidden in train, imitation_demo, reward design, opponent pool, benchmark candidate/incumbent, and final evaluation.

config.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators (',', ':')

final.seed_roster_order: root ascending, then target seat 0 then 1
final.prohibition: No read, execution, labels, outcomes, or derived strategic signal before the candidate is frozen; no training, imitation, reward, validation, pool, or checkpoint selection use.

schedule_digest_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; NFC strings; object keys lexicographically sorted; compact separators; no floats; exact keys validated before hashing.
schedule_digest_contract.schedule_spec_digest: SHA-256 canonical JSON with successor seed-plan SHA, codec/version/domain labels (including imitation initial/reset), per-split run-key/UUID binding, tuple field schema/order, deterministic tuple-generation rules, immutable partition/root bounds and reserved-root behavior, registry/lock rules, and allowed paired-tuple reuse rule; one common immutable digest.
schedule_digest_contract.expanded_schedule_digest: SHA-256 canonical JSON with exactly schedule_spec_digest, suite_id, run_id, run_key, slots, collision_scan. Complete finite upper-bound roster only; no runtime outcomes or post-hoc exclusion changes.
schedule_digest_contract.slot_order: suite order train, imitation_demo, benchmark, validation, final; then root order in seed-plan, arena_index, update_index, rollout_index, game_index, reset_index, slot_id.
schedule_digest_contract.slot_schema: Each slot has exactly slot_id, suite_ordinal, root_ordinal, the nine seed-tuple fields in codec order, derived_seed_uint64, preregistered status, protocol_exclusion_reason. slot_id is SHA-256 canonical JSON of suite_id, run_id, backend_id, root_ordinal, and all nine tuple fields; backend_id incumbent/candidate only for paired measured entries, shared otherwise.
schedule_digest_contract.collision_scan: Scan complete upper-bound roster, including all preallocated reset tuples and cross-suite reservations; duplicate groups sorted ascending derived seed, members by canonical slot_id UTF-8 bytes, and include derived seed, slot IDs and exact tuples. Only identical measured pair tuple shared by incumbent/candidate is allowed; fail closed otherwise.
schedule_digest_contract.realized_schedule_digest: After completed workload, SHA-256 canonical JSON with exactly parent_expanded_schedule_digest, realized_slots, realized_tuple_list, episode_outcomes; never mutates expanded schedule.

registry_lock_lifecycle.registry: Single append-only global registry; zero-based consecutive event_index, genesis prev_event_hash=64 zeroes; canonical event payload has exactly event_index,event_type,event_data,prev_event_hash; strings NFC, sorted compact JSON, no floats; event_hash=SHA-256(payload bytes), not included inside payload.
registry_lock_lifecycle.pre_lock_benchmark_artifact: At creation, bind immutable benchmark artifact SHA-256, then-current pre_lock_head_hash and final event index (null/-1 for empty prefix), and exact earlier benchmark registration event index/hash. The future lock_head_hash MUST NOT be required or inserted into immutable artifact bytes.
registry_lock_lifecycle.lock_event: Pin pre-lock prefix head and last event index (or null/-1 empty). Append next registration_closed event with index pre_lock_final_event_index+1, prev_event_hash=pre_lock_head_hash, and event_data containing exactly the two pinned pre-lock fields. Hash canonical event payload; resulting event_hash is lock_head_hash.
registry_lock_lifecycle.post_lock_benchmark_attestation: After lock, append separate benchmark_attestation event per eligible pre-lock artifact, binding unchanged artifact content hash, original prefix head/index, exact benchmark registration event/hash, and resulting lock_head_hash. Do not mutate artifact bytes. No downstream consumer can use pre-lock benchmark artifact until exact attestation validates.
registry_lock_lifecycle.lock_sequence: Phase A freeze seed-plan SHA, global schedule digest, complete benchmark/validation/final rosters and collision scans. Phase B minimal guards at existing consumer boundaries and rejection tests only. Register and budget-check every intended workload, plus validation/final reservation metadata; then append irreversible registration_closed lock before any training/imitation/strategic workload or strategic outcome access. Workload/artifacts pin lock_head_hash.
registry_lock_lifecycle.post_lock: No registrations or identity/schedule/bounds/root/roster mutation after lock; only registered run completion/evidence and required benchmark_attestation events may append. Validation can run after lock only for promotion of registered candidates on frozen validation suite. Final suite is inaccessible until candidate freeze and final evaluator; no final data in selection.
registry_lock_lifecycle.integrity_limit: Hash chain detects partial/inconsistent edits only if independent anchors are preserved; it is not a signature and does not resist rewriting the complete registry and every anchor.

phase_a_workload_prerequisite: No benchmark, training, Kaggle, validation, or final workload may execute until this seed-plan and evidence roster are reviewed, all applicable Phase-B guard/rejection tests pass, required registrations and budget checks are complete, and the irreversible registration_closed lock is appended. This is a permanent protocol rule, not a claim about current review status.
